description: This file declares the MessageDispatcher class, which implements the IMessageDispatcher interface and manages media key clients for license requests, renewals, and key status changes. It also defines an inner class MessageDispatcherClient for client management.

classes.name: MessageDispatcher
classes.description: Implements message dispatching for media key license requests, renewals, and status changes, managing multiple clients with thread safety.

classes.name: MessageDispatcher::MessageDispatcherClient
classes.description: Inner class that manages individual media key client instances, linking them to the dispatcher.

methods.name: MessageDispatcher::createClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a new client for media key interactions.

methods.name: MessageDispatcher::onLicenseRequest
methods.description: Handles license request messages for a given key session.

methods.name: MessageDispatcher::onLicenseRenewal
methods.description: Handles license renewal messages for a given key session.

methods.name: MessageDispatcher::onKeyStatusesChanged
methods.description: Handles updates to key statuses for a given key session.

methods.name: MessageDispatcher::addClient
methods.description: Adds a media key client to the internal set.

methods.name: MessageDispatcher::removeClient
methods.description: Removes a media key client from the internal set.
